accepted_changes.assessment: The roster name button invokes the actual function. refreshPortfolioDropdown populates stale options before setting the target; switchTab then preserves that valid selection during its own refresh and invokes the existing renderer once. Removing explicit render/export updates avoids double rendering because refresh and render already update export state. The select object remains the same; refresh only replaces option children.

Absent tool select remains tolerated. Absent portfolio select still opens the Portfolio panel and safely skips content/scroll; the existing renderer returns. Missing scroll section remains a no-op. Selection persistence remains best effort with its prior bytes retained on failure. Required tab-shell elements are guarded by the unchanged switchTab and are present in shipped HTML; the repair does not promise rendering with a missing shell. Two cheap dropdown refreshes are an accepted cost of preserving correct target selection before the one render.

The only owner/write operations remain the existing selectedStudent/tool selection and best-effort selected-student storage update. Navigation adds no writing/photo/OCR/report/pending/source clear. Different-student navigation still closes the crop session before changing owner; same-student navigation retains it. The new clauses reject parsed source or target indices outside the current queue before geometry, splice, queue replacement or OCR invalidation. The prior NaN/equality checks, parseInt behavior, drag-index fallback and terminal cleanup remain unchanged. Valid zero and last-element indices are retained. This prevents the demonstrated negative-index mutation and out-of-range undefined insertion without broadening accepted input.

Desktop X versus mobile Y half-target insertion, source-index adjustment and final clamping are byte-identical after the guard. Valid reorder still retains the photo objects/bytes/revisions, clears OCR caches, updates primary-photo state and closes an obsolete crop session through the unchanged syncSelectedImageState ownership check. Rejected drops perform only drag-class/index cleanup. Pending references and durable writing are not modified by the added guard.
